title: Sixeyes Vanilla Sprinkles
description: A mod that adds plenty of drop-like additions that aim to improve the overall quality of life.
body:
To coincide with Minecraft's new release structure of Game Drops, this mod aims to add individual features or sets of features that fit the scale of a single game drop. The design of the added features is based around the known design guidelines shared by Mojang so far.

## **Current features include:**

### - **Rake tool**
- Allows player to move piles of leaf litter and add them together. Cannot stack leaf litter piles more than the maximum amount of 4 segments per block. While standing on a leaf litter pile and using the Rake, you can rotate the pile 90 degrees clockwise.
- Crafted with two sticks and any stone crafting variant
- Has 256 durability
